info.title: smapass-back API
info.description: IMEI-managed devices with Android hardware key attestation, proof of possession and anonymous app credentials. Signed log ingestion, grading, certificate issuance and chain anchoring are not implemented.

get.summary: Read the latest issued snapshot by IMEI, including released registrations and revoked snapshots

parameters.name: imeis
parameters.description: Comma-separated IMEIs (1 to 50); duplicates and aliases resolve to one latest issued snapshot per device, ordered by primary IMEI.

get.description: Public references use primary or secondary IMEI only. Lifetime device history remains readable after registration release, transfer, or certificate revocation. Certificate UUIDs and short numbers are not accepted or returned. No issued snapshot returns 404; GET /api/devices/{imei} remains available for a known device even without issuance. An old seller listing is omitted after registration release.

get.description: Returns 200 for any known IMEI including before certificate issuance, during sale with a released registration, after transfer, and after certificate revocation. Specs, latest measurements and counts span all registration periods. Missing observations and an unissued certificate are null. Measurements are observations, not proof of verification. Unknown devices return 404; owner identity, credentials and private attestation are never returned.

post.summary: Verify and atomically append one signed spec or status measurement by IMEI

201.description: Signature verified; raw signed bytes and projection stored atomically

200.description: Exact retry; original receipt returned, activity timestamp unchanged

400.description: Invalid JSON, JCS, envelope, timestamp, measurement or Base64 encoding

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked device credentials

403.description: Invalid signature, inactive key or key without verified hardware attestation

409.description: Sequence gap, previous hash mismatch, or conflicting retry

500.description: Internal persistence failure; transaction rolled back

post.description: Bearer token required. The path accepts a primary or secondary IMEI; the signed envelope must use the primary IMEI and registered key UUID. canonical_payload must be the exact RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 JSON string of MeasurementPayload, with all nullable fields included. Sign its UTF-8 bytes using SHA256withECDSA (P-256), encode the ASN.1 DER signature in standard Base64. Only the current attested key can append. All logs share an IMEI-wide sequence across key and holder changes. Exact retries from the current registration return the original receipt without extending registration activity. State and status history become readable immediately; this does not issue certificates, compute grades, verify physical measurement truth, or anchor to a chain. Body limit: 128 KiB; signed payload limit: 64 KiB.

canonical_payload.description: Exact UTF-8 RFC 8785 JSON string for MeasurementPayload. The byte limit is also enforced server-side.

signature_der.description: P-256 SHA256withECDSA ASN.1 DER signature, standard Base64.

collected_at.description: UTC RFC 3339, at most six fractional digits, no redundant trailing zeroes; from 1970 to server time +5 minutes. Offline past observations are accepted.

previous_hash.description: null for sequence 1; otherwise SHA-256 of the immediately preceding log canonical bytes, even across registrants.

spec.description: Required object only for type=spec, otherwise null. Device names and arbitrary private fields are not accepted.

status.description: Required object only for type=status, otherwise null. Every unknown observation must be null.

signature_verified.description: Signature verification succeeded; does not attest measurement truth or chain inclusion.
